label: 水面微动
motion: Small ripples brighten and settle within the selected water surface. Figures at the bank hold their original poses.
mask_note: Geometric support only. Trace the actual water edge before production.

label: 枝叶轻摆
motion: The selected foliage tips sway a tiny distance once and return. Branches and architecture hold their original positions.
mask_note: Geometric support only. Isolate foliage and protect neighbouring figures.

label: 人物动作候选
motion: Select one figure inside this candidate area before generation. One small head inclination returns to the original pose; feet and hands hold position.
mask_note: Candidate location, not a finished figure segmentation. Move the region if any complete figure or its proposed motion would cross the edge.

label: 远城左侧火光
motion: A dim orange glow in the existing distant fire openings slowly brightens and settles. The building silhouettes hold their painted edges.
mask_note: Trace existing fire openings. Do not animate the rectangular background as a whole.

label: 远城右侧火光
motion: A second small group of existing painted fire openings pulses gently, independently of the other fire region. Buildings stay fixed.
mask_note: Generate independently; keep context and outer guard band static.

label: 烟雾候选
motion: One faint wisp of smoke rises a short distance from the selected opening and dissipates. Surrounding painted forms remain fixed.
mask_note: Candidate smoke region. Manual mask refinement and endpoint inspection required.
